title: Concept: XML parser with entities enabled (javascript) — review required
description: In javascript, parseXml(s, {noent: true}) switches entity processing on. XXE payloads abuse doctypes to exfiltrate files and scan networks through the parser's authority. The remedy is disabling entities via noent: false.
applicability: javascript XML parsing configuration; single-line lexical scope.
risk: File disclosure and SSRF through malicious XML; HIGH severity.
